name: RAG Ladder Cheat Sheet 📖

# What You Get

- A complete 10-level ladder from simple “just paste it” context dumps to cutting-edge Agentic GraphRAG, with setup time, cost, accuracy, and best-fit use cases at every stage.

- A decision framework that helps you stop over-engineering, cut costs, and pick the simplest RAG level that actually works for your business.

- Pro tips, fatal flaw call-outs, and a cost-reality breakdown so you can scale knowledge retrieval without burning time or budget
